author: Yffe
content: Failing test at forge/tests/divergence_c12_map_goldens_missing.rs::divergence_c12_map_cert_and_lowering_goldens_exist demonstrates the divergence: 13-map.md Acceptance criteria mandates conformance/map_kv.cert.json (cert oracle, goal.md model B) and tests/golden/lower/map_kv.verus.rs (golden lowering, goal.md model A); 0c75cc0 ships neither (only conformance/map_kv.th). Verified only by the real-verus-on-emitted harness, which is a weaker oracle than the design-mandated diffable goldens. C7-#100 oracle-gap class. ALSO: tooling/spec-routes.toml carries only the lower.rs route (reference is the stale non-existent 'conformance/map'; should be the AC artifacts), and the design-mandated ast.rs/parser.rs/validator.rs routes are absent.
